candidate_reports.remark: Video of the Escalante River hitting the bottom of the bridge on 300 east north of town.
Mohave County camera showed high flows on Short Creek.
Videos show a large flood on the Escalante River with a foot bridge over topped and the river well out of banks. Time is estimated.
Large flood wave passed the US-89 Gauge on the Paria River. Flood remained very elevated through the overnight hours.
East Fork of the Virgin River had another flood wave_ around 1300 cfs hit the gauge.
Final flood wave_ around 600 cfs_ hit the gauge on the East Fork of the Virgin River.
Flood wave overtopped road around 130 PM.
Initial flood wave hit the US-89 gauge on the Paria River.
